confirmed.search: eor is inside-current-conversation search (message matches/index). It cannot establish sidebar history search semantics. Ordinary sidebar search service/pagination still needs separate owner trace.
confirmed.composer: Chat/Work mode toggle capability gated in l3f. w7o optional slot mdo/ldo/ndo/null is capability-based; Work=Expanded and Chat=permanently compact are not universal official rules. Null-slot Chat fixture and explicit Work slot are independent capability choices.
